# Work with us
:::

::::: {.wrap .page-body}
:::: prose
We're a new lab at Texas A&M and are building the group now. If you're curious about turbulence, enjoy working with real field data and want to learn large-eddy simulation, get in touch.

## Prospective PhD and MS students

Students with backgrounds in atmospheric science, physics, mechanical or civil engineering, or applied math are all welcome. Programming experience in Python, R or Fortran helps; we'll teach you the rest.

- Email a short note on your research interests, along with your CV.
- Apply to the Texas A&M Atmospheric Sciences graduate program and mention the lab in your application.

## Postdocs

There are no open postdoc positions right now. If you're interested in fellowships that we could apply for together, please get in touch.

## Undergraduates

Texas A&M undergraduates interested in research for credit or summer projects are welcome to email.
